about: The HCP agent list, its after-revoke notice lines and the HCP Revoke sheet (step 7.27, backlog Section C part U2). Read with agent-connect-screens.json by the screen catalogue, with the same fields. HCP words are the Hcp.<key> ids of hcp/copy.ts, read back through __tests__/fixtures/hcpWordSource.ts. Agent names and times are data, not words, so no entry lists them.
